title: Object URI type names for chat, calendar, task, filenode, scene, VTC types
description: graph-projection projects only types with registered JMAP Object URN type names; it registers RFC 8621/9610 types only. Calendar, TaskList, FileNode, and JMAP Chat types need registrations. JMAP Chat's Chat type cannot be 'chat' (collides with urn:jmap:chat capability segment); needs another name. Also: Object URN definition lives in chat-calendars draft, an awkward normative dependency for jmap-graph-projection; consider moving it to a standalone doc.
notes:
After urn:ietf:params:jmap: rename (k16o): type names also may not equal core capability segments; FileNode cannot be 'filenode' (urn:ietf:params:jmap:filenode). Object URN definition now lives in sub-namespace assigned by JMAP-CHAT iana-urn section.
SUPERSEDED constraint: after move to jmap: URI scheme, type names no longer collide with capability segments; Chat may be 'chat' and FileNode 'filenode'. Registry renamed JMAP Object URI Types.
Mark 2026-10-20: include scene + VTC types; Option A (each owner draft registers its own types).
close_reason: Registered object URI type names in owner drafts (Option A): chat-00 9 chat types, chat-calendars +calendar, chat-tasks +tasklist, chat-filenode filenode, scene 4, vtc 4; projection note updated. 30 type names total, mechanically checked unique and lowercase-matching.
